name: chip-manager
description: Panel of the actions suggested by sessions: editable order, engine (Claude/Codex) and reviewer, single or bulk start with the rules of routing.json, live state and milestone progress. Interface in English, Italian, Spanish, French, German and Brazilian Portuguese

anthropicAdminKey.title: Anthropic Admin API
anthropicAdminKey.description: Admin key for API spend; only with Claude enabled in the project.

anthropicApiKey.title: Anthropic API (credits)
anthropicApiKey.description: Key for running chips on API credits (API Claude destination). Use a dedicated key in a Console workspace with a low monthly spend limit.

deepseekKey.title: DeepSeek API
deepseekKey.description: Key to read the balance; requires a per-project opt-in.

freellmapiKey.title: FreeLLMAPI
freellmapiKey.description: Unified key from the local dashboard; requires a per-project opt-in.

openrouterKey.title: OpenRouter API
openrouterKey.description: Key from openrouter.ai/settings/keys; text-only chips, requires a per-project opt-in.

qwenKey.title: Qwen API (Model Studio)
qwenKey.description: Key from Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, for the region chosen in Settings; requires a per-project opt-in.

mistralKey.title: Mistral API
mistralKey.description: Key from console.mistral.ai/api-keys; text-only chips, requires a per-project opt-in.

groqKey.title: Groq API
groqKey.description: Key from console.groq.com/keys; text-only chips, requires a per-project opt-in.

lmstudioKey.title: LM Studio token (optional)
lmstudioKey.description: Only if the local LM Studio server requires an API token.

vllmKey.title: vLLM key (optional)
vllmKey.description: Only if the local vLLM server was started with an API key.

paralleli.title: Parallel sessions
paralleli.description: How many sessions started from the panel can run together; the others stay queued.
